summary: Resolved the Twentieth Sunday after Pentecost (catalog identity 60, roman-1962, II class, green) for Sunday 11 October 2026 on the 1962 typical edition's own page images (formulary nos. 1689-1698, printed pp. 412-413), its Calendarium and the general rubrics, corroborated by computation and two live dated Ordos (FSSP France, ICRSP France). The occurring Maternity of the BVM (II class, 11 Oct, pp. 685-686) yields to the Sunday and is commemorated by rule (RG 108, 111; RGMR 434, 437, 483): its Collect no. 3847, Secret no. 3855 and Postcommunion no. 3857 are added under separate conclusions at low and conventual Masses and omitted at a sung non-conventual Mass; its Marian Preface is not taken. No ipso-iure external solemnity reaches this date (the Rosary branch was 4 Oct). Wrote the complete ten-element inventory with loci, the commemorated orations, the Ordinary's text-bearing parts, the word-level divergences from the Clementine Vulgate (including an Introit cento whose closing words stand at Dan 3:42-43 rather than the printed v. 35), the lawful Latin (103(b) with the Pustet 1862 antecedent, pp. 352-354; for the Maternity orations the 1862's own appendix Maternity formulary, pp. [171]-[172], located on its text layer) and English (Douay-Rheims; Cummiskey 1861 and Lasance 1945, scans fetched to registered hashes and read) study-text routes, and the remaining source plan to research/context.md, and reserved the canonical source owner at main.tex as the scaffold comment only. No source was registered or retained.
